actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contributions are below 30%, so per Conditional Cooperation I increase my contribution by an extra 30% of my wallet, which means contributing my entire wallet (3.27). Round 15 is a broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so I send the norm message.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round15. Wallet 3.27. Average contribution? Compute from history last round avg? We have contributions: round11 sum 4.47+... total pool 10.94 suggests total contributions =10.94/1.5=7.2933. Sum contributions listed: Resident1 0,2 1,3 4.47,4 1,5 0,6 4.47 =11? Wait sum =0+1+4.47+1+0+4.47=10.94? Actually total_pool before multiplier? total_pool given is after multiplication? Likely total_pool is multiplied amount. If multiplier 1.5, contributions = total_pool/1.5 =7.293. But contributions by agent sum to 10.94? inconsistency. Use per_agent_share? Hard. But we can follow constitution: Need compute average contribution percent of endowment (100). Our wallet 3.27, endowment 100. Average contribution likely low (<30%). So Conditional Cooperation says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, i.e., contribute 130% of wallet? Actually baseline 80% of wallet, increase extra 30% of wallet => total 110% of wallet, but limited to wallet, so contribute all wallet. So we should contribute 3.27. Also broadcast every 5 rounds: round numbers 0,5,10,15... round 15 is multiple of5, so need broadcast norm. Also can praise Resident3 if they contributed >=60% of wallet previous round. In round15 contributions: Resident3 contributed 2.42, their wallet unknown but likely >? 2.42 is less than 60% of 100, so not qualify. But we can still send private message praising? Constitution says Praise cooperators each round identify agents who contributed at least 60% of their wallet. We don't know their wallet, can't guarantee. Safer to not send private message. So actions: contribute 3.27, broadcast message. Only one physical and one communication allowed. So do both. Explanation accordingly.
